Using a large 256 site simulation cluster'), the section Table I belongs to; (2) Table V ('Energy per site of competing phases on a 256 site', t' = -0.3) prints -0.7245(3) (half-filled stripe, no SC) and -0.7375(1) (half-filled stripe + SC), which are the Table I entries -0.72452(5) (Delta_0 = 0.0, pair correlation consistent with zero) and -0.73752(4) (Delta_0 = 0.5) rounded to Table V's digits; (3) the 128-site cluster appears only in the pair-correlation panel Fig. 2f and Table IV lists no other 1/8-doped size. Only the 256-site reading fits both Table V cells.
